rows.question: Identify a list of genes expressed in lung cancer
rows.pred_sql:
WITH disease_mutation_mapped_genes AS (
  SELECT
    dm.id AS id,
    dm.doid AS doid,
    m.ensembl_transcript_id AS ensembl_transcript_id,
    m.uniprotkb_ac AS uniprotkb_ac,
    x.ensembl_gene_id AS ensembl_gene_id,
    x.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol
  FROM disease_mutation dm
  JOIN map_protein_disease_mutation m
    ON m.ensembl_transcript_id = dm.ensembl_transcript_id
  LEFT JOIN map_uniprot_canonical_id u
    ON u.uniprotkb_ac = m.uniprotkb_ac
  LEFT JOIN xref_gene_ensembl x
    ON x.ensembl_gene_id = m.ensembl_transcript_id
),
differential_expression_by_doid AS (
  SELECT
    de.gene_symbol,
    de.doid,
    de.log2fc,
    de.pvalue,
    de.adjpvalue,
    de.statistical_significance,
    de.expression_change_direction,
    de.subjects_total
  FROM differential_expression de
),
healthy_expression_by_uberon AS (
  SELECT
    ensembl_gene_id,
    uberon_anatomical_id,
    uberon_developmental_id,
    expression_level_gene_relative,
    expression_level_anatomical_relative,
    expression_rank_score,
    expression_score,
    call_quality
  FROM healthy_expression
)
SELECT
  gene_symbol,
  string_agg(DISTINCT source, ',' ORDER BY source) AS sources,
  json_agg(evidence) FILTER (WHERE evidence IS NOT NULL) AS evidences
FROM (
  -- differential expression in lung cancer (doid = 1324)
  SELECT
    de.gene_symbol::text AS gene_symbol,
    'differential_expression' AS source,
    json_build_object(
      'source','differential_expression',
      'log2fc', de.log2fc,
      'pvalue', de.pvalue,
      'adjpvalue', de.adjpvalue,
      'statistical_significance', de.statistical_significance
    )::json AS evidence
  FROM differential_expression_by_doid de
  WHERE de.doid = 1324
    AND de.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  -- healthy expression in anatomical sites linked to lung cancer (via cancer_tissue)
  SELECT
    coalesce(x.gene_symbol, '')::text AS gene_symbol,
    'healthy_expression' AS source,
    json_build_object(
      'source','healthy_expression',
      'ensembl_gene_id', h.ensembl_gene_id,
      'uberon_anatomical_id', h.uberon_anatomical_id,
      'expression_level_gene_relative', h.expression_level_gene_relative,
      'expression_score', h.expression_score,
      'expression_rank_score', h.expression_rank_score,
      'call_quality', h.call_quality
    )::json AS evidence
  FROM cancer_tissue ct
  JOIN healthy_expression_by_uberon h
    ON h.uberon_anatomical_id = ct.uberon_anatomical_id
  LEFT JOIN xref_gene_ensembl x
    ON x.ensembl_gene_id = h.ensembl_gene_id
  WHERE ct.doid = 1324
    AND coalesce(x.gene_symbol, '') <> ''

  UNION ALL

  -- genes from disease mutations mapped to genes for lung cancer (doid = 1324)
  SELECT
    coalesce(dm.gene_symbol, x.gene_symbol)::text AS gene_symbol,
    'disease_mutation_mapped_genes' AS source,
    json_build_object(
      'source','disease_mutation_mapped_genes',
      'disease_mutation_id', dm.id,
      'ensembl_transcript_id', dm.ensembl_transcript_id,
      'ensembl_gene_id', dm.ensembl_gene_id,
      'uniprotkb_ac', dm.uniprotkb_ac
    )::json AS evidence
  FROM disease_mutation_mapped_genes dm
  LEFT JOIN xref_gene_ensembl x
    ON x.ensembl_gene_id = dm.ensembl_gene_id
  WHERE dm.doid = 1324
    AND coalesce(dm.gene_symbol, x.gene_symbol) IS NOT NULL
) t
WHERE gene_symbol <> ''
GROUP BY gene_symbol
ORDER BY gene_symbol

rows.question: Show biomarker gene symbol and description for 'breast cancer'
rows.pred_sql:
WITH disease_by_id AS (
  SELECT
    d.id AS id,
    d.name AS name
  FROM disease d
),
biomarker_core AS (
  SELECT
    b.id AS id,
    COALESCE(b.gene_symbol, '') AS gene_symbol,
    COALESCE(b.biomarker_description, '') AS biomarker_description
  FROM biomarker b
),
-- attempt to associate biomarkers to diseases via explicit FDA test doid when available
biomarker_fda_doid AS (
  SELECT
    b.id AS biomarker_id,
    fda.doid::bigint AS doid
  FROM biomarker b
  LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda bf ON bf.id = b.id
  LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda_test fda
    ON fda.test_trade_name = bf.test_trade_name
       AND fda.test_submission = bf.test_submission
  WHERE fda.doid IS NOT NULL
),
-- fallback textual associations: match disease.name to biomarker gene_symbol or biomarker_description (case-insensitive)
biomarker_text_match AS (
  SELECT
    b.id AS biomarker_id,
    d.id AS doid,
    'text_match' AS source,
    CASE
      WHEN position(lower(d.name) in lower(COALESCE(b.gene_symbol, ''))) > 0 THEN 'gene_symbol'
      WHEN position(lower(d.name) in lower(COALESCE(b.biomarker_description, ''))) > 0 THEN 'biomarker_description'
      ELSE 'none'
    END AS match_field
  FROM biomarker b
  JOIN disease d
    ON (
      (COALESCE(b.gene_symbol, '') <> '' AND position(lower(d.name) in lower(b.gene_symbol)) > 0)
      OR (COALESCE(b.biomarker_description, '') <> '' AND position(lower(d.name) in lower(b.biomarker_description)) > 0)
    )
),
-- union explicit and textual associations
biomarker_to_disease AS (
  SELECT biomarker_id, doid FROM biomarker_fda_doid
  UNION
  SELECT biomarker_id, doid FROM biomarker_text_match
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  bc.gene_symbol,
  bc.biomarker_description
FROM biomarker_core bc
LEFT JOIN biomarker_to_disease btd
  ON bc.id = btd.biomarker_id
LEFT JOIN disease_by_id d
  ON d.id = btd.doid
WHERE
  (
    -- direct disease match by name if we have an associated disease row
    d.name ILIKE 'breast cancer'
    -- or textual fallback: gene_symbol or biomarker_description contains 'breast' (case-insensitive)
    OR bc.gene_symbol ILIKE '%breast%'
    OR bc.biomarker_description ILIKE '%breast%'
  )
ORDER BY bc.gene_symbol

rows.question: What are the name of cancer types where the A1BG gene expression is significantly increased (up regulated)
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT d.name AS disease_name
FROM differential_expression de
JOIN disease d ON de.doid = d.id
WHERE de.gene_symbol = 'A1BG'
  AND (
    -- expression direction indicates up-regulation
    (de.expression_change_direction IS NOT NULL AND de.expression_change_direction ILIKE '%up%')
    -- and the change is statistically significant: textual flag or adjusted p-value threshold
    AND (
      (de.statistical_significance IS NOT NULL AND de.statistical_significance ILIKE '%significant%')
      OR (de.statistical_significance IS NOT NULL AND de.statistical_significance IN ('yes','true'))
      OR (de.adjpvalue IS NOT NULL AND de.adjpvalue < 0.05)
    )
  )
ORDER BY disease_name

rows.question: What is the test trade name for FDA tests which are actually used for predisposition?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH fda_tests_rowlevel AS (
SELECT
  test_submission,
  test_trade_name,
  test_manufacturer,
  test_approval_status,
  test_adoption_evidence,
  platform_method,
  test_number_genes,
  clinical_significance,
  biomarker_origin,
  doid,
  histological_type,
  specimen_type
FROM biomarker_fda_test
),
fda_test_use_with_test AS (
SELECT
  tufu.id AS id,
  tufu.test_trade_name AS test_trade_name,
  tufu.test_submission AS test_submission,
  tufu.actual_use AS actual_use,
  tufu.approved_indication AS approved_indication,
  ft.test_manufacturer AS test_manufacturer,
  ft.test_approval_status AS test_approval_status,
  ft.platform_method AS platform_method,
  ft.specimen_type AS specimen_type,
  ft.clinical_significance AS clinical_significance
FROM
  biomarker_fda_test_use tufu
LEFT JOIN
  -- join to fda test metadata on the composite natural key (lifted literals: none)
  biomarker_fda_test ft
ON
  ( (tufu.test_trade_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ft.test_trade_name)
    AND (tufu.test_submission IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ft.test_submission) )
),
fda_tests_canonical AS (
SELECT
  test_trade_name,
  test_submission,
  test_manufacturer,
  biomarker_origin,
  test_approval_status,
  clinical_significance,
  test_number_genes,
  platform_method,
  specimen_type
FROM
  biomarker_fda_test
),
fda_test_use_rows AS (
SELECT
  id,
  test_trade_name,
  test_submission,
  approved_indication,
  actual_use
FROM biomarker_fda_test_use
)
SELECT DISTINCT test_trade_name
FROM fda_test_use_with_test
WHERE actual_use = 'predisposition'
  AND test_trade_name IS NOT NULL
